text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"གཟུགས་ཅན་གྱི་ཆོས་རྣམས་ནི་ཡུལ་ན་མི་#གནས་པའི་ཕྱིར་རོ།","english":"because material phenomena do not fail to reside in an object.","kind":"negation","why":"The source says material phenomena do not reside in an object, but the English says they do not fail to reside (i.e., they do reside).","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: because material phenomena do not fail to reside in an object.
contradictions.why: The source says material phenomena do not reside in an object, but the English says they do not fail to reside (i.e., they do reside).
